activity_summary: Pope had not landed Buckingham's speech when Burbage began the King's answer. You asked him to wait, and not to announce the wait. It was gone nine, and you had them do it twice. Burbage made the pause so large that the waiting itself commanded the stage. The second time, his answer was smaller than the shout he had ready. Pope said the empty yard took it. You said the empty yard changed more than it did under the louder reading. For a moment the King heard something he did not expect. You left the note to be written before you left the house.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Started early, then made the wait another way of commanding, and left the writing to you.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Kept Buckingham unfinished until the speech had landed, and felt the yard take the smaller answer.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked for the wait, forbade an announcement, and kept the note for the tables.

facets.activity: Asked Burbage to let Buckingham finish

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I will make it so large the yard will think the waiting is the crown

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The empty yard changed more than it did under the louder reading
